title: Degree cutoff
statement: For natural numbers $d$ and $s$ and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the degree cutoff to be the natural-number ceiling of three times the output cutoff at tolerance $\varepsilon/12$, divided by the circuit compression rate at the width cutoff for $s$ and tolerance $\varepsilon$, and the layer cutoff for $s$ and tolerance $\varepsilon/12$, raised to the power given by $d-2$ with truncated natural subtraction.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the width-truncation cutoff used by the output, width, and layer cutoffs, so these components cannot be made more explicit from this payload.
